parameters.query: SELECT s."userId", COALESCE(NULLIF(TRIM(u."name"),''), u."email") AS "fullName", COALESCE(NULLIF(s."startTime",''), '10:30') AS "expectedAt" FROM "Schedule" s JOIN "User" u ON u.id = s."userId" WHERE s."storeId" = 'clarvex-demo-store' AND u."active" = true AND u."checklistOnly" = false AND u."isDemo" = false AND s.status = 'WORKING' AND to_char(s."date" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Monterrey','YYYY-MM-DD') = to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Monterrey'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AND NOT EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM "Attendance" a WHERE a."userId" = s."userId" AND to_char(a."date" AT TIME ZONE 'America/Monterrey','YYYY-MM-DD') = to_char((now() AT TIME ZONE 'America/Monterrey'),'YYYY-MM-DD') AND NULLIF(TRIM(a."arrivedAt"),'') IS NOT NULL) ORDER BY "fullName";
